title.purpose: Page titles, wordmark, sign-in headline only.

kpi.purpose: Headline figures in the KPI strip.

body.purpose: Default text and tables, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, toasts, command palette, select listbox. Nothing else.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Focused or open inputs and select triggers.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals: rises, menus opening, toasts, bars growing.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Shared-element moves (customer-id view transition), error shake.

motion.name: stagger-rise
motion.purpose: Panels arriving on a page; fill-mode backwards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view; cobalt.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral outline; also used for destructive admin actions (never red).

components.name: Sidebar Link
components.description: Frame navigation row; active state is a darker frame wash, not an accent.

components.name: Risk Pill
components.description: Status pill; text label always present. Red only for customer risk.

components.name: KPI Strip
components.description: One divided container of key figures, not separate tiles.

components.name: Data Bar
components.description: Cobalt bar on cobalt-tint track; grows from zero.

components.name: Undo Toast
components.description: Floating ink toast with an Undo action and a 5s cobalt drain bar.
components.css: .ds-toast{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-width:280px;padding:10px 10px 10px 16px;background:var(--ink,#1e1810);color:var(--sheet,#fffdf9);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(44,31,11,.16),0 2px 6px rgba(44,31,11,.08);font:600 13.5px 'Manrope Variable','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-toast span{flex:1}.ds-toast button{height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,253,249,.16);color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-toast i{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:3px;width:100%;background:var(--accent,#2a54c4);transform-origin:left;animation:ds-drain 5s linear forwards}@keyframes ds-drain{to{transform:scaleX(0)}}

narrative.overview: An apricot frame holds the tools; a near-white sheet holds the work. The frame is the only place warmth is loud. Inside the sheet the palette goes quiet: warm-neutral ink and hairlines, cobalt for data and the single primary action, red reserved for a customer at risk.
keyCharacteristics: Apricot L-frame + near-white sheet; no resting shadows.
Cobalt = data and the one primary action. Red = customer risk only.
Bricolage Grotesque for page titles, wordmark and sign-in headline only; Manrope with tabular figures for everything else.
Money has no currency symbol (the dataset has none); percentages show 2 decimals.
Motion has a fixed vocabulary of three easings and is fully reducible.

rules.name: The Red-Means-Risk Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for a customer at risk. Destructive admin actions are neutral outlines on purpose, protected by explicit steps rather than by colour.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks data and the single primary action. The frame and chrome never take the accent colour.

rules.name: The Not-By-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status pill carries a text label (and a dot); colour never carries status alone.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is for page titles, the wordmark and the sign-in headline. Never for body, tables, buttons, labels or KPI figures.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: All figures use tabular numerals; numbers in tables are right-aligned.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: No resting shadow on sheet, panels, KPI strip, buttons or table rows. Only elements that detach from the page take Float.

dos: Do keep red for customer risk only; use neutral outlines for destructive admin buttons.
Do use cobalt for data and exactly one primary action per view.
Do read colours from the CSS custom properties so light and dark both work; add dark values wherever you add a token.
Do keep the sheet and panels flat; use Float only for menus, popovers, toasts and the palette.
Do use Bricolage for titles and the wordmark only; Manrope with tabular figures elsewhere; right-align numbers.
Do show money without a currency symbol and percentages with 2 decimals.
Do use Undo toasts for reversible actions; keep security and admin actions explicit.
Do use the three named easings and respect reduced motion; keep content visible at rest.
donts: Don't add icon-in-circle KPI tiles, sparklines, gradients, eyebrows, uppercase tracked headers, zebra tables or confirm() dialogs for reversible actions.
Don't put the accent colour on the frame or chrome.
Don't add resting shadows or glass; the only glass is the theme-switch thumb, by the user's request.
Don't show status by colour alone.
Don't use a native <select> for filters; use the animated Select.
